name: FoodScaling
title: Food Scaling
author: Vatroslav
description:
Food that heals over time also heals a share of your max health: 8% for weak food, 16% for medium, 30% for strong. The pace stays the same, the healing lasts longer. Drinks and healing plants that heal over time get it too.

Adjust or turn it off in Settings > Game > Food Scaling.
